notes.title: New game news!
notes.content:
Hello.
Momentum Games.

I would like to share some happy news with you today.
With your lots of interest and love, Momentum Games continues to grow. 

I am always grateful for your help. 
The good news we bring to you this time is that Momentum Games will be publishing in June and will be releasing five new titles to everyone.
I want to show you. 

We decided to help small-scale developers release games on Steam. 
There may not be enough parts, but we worked hard to develop it with passion, so we appreciate your interest and ""Add to your WishList."" 

 I will now share a brief introduction and link. 

[h2][b]1.Sex Counselor[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41454859/5961549b1bd8784b8753a2362127c9c717971821.png[/img]
This is a story about recovering the memories of the game and winning over female college students through counseling.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954830/Sex_Counselor/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954830/Sex_Counselor/[/url]

[h2][b]2.Secret Toy[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41454859/3bb8d1be635efdfbd86c100e89e5ee3a713abd1f.jpg[/img]
This is a management/tycoon game where you can develop adult products and test them directly.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2961330/Secret_Toy/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2961330/Secret_Toy/[/url]

[h2][b]3.Angry Boy[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41454859/7ffb26c30a6cbe718b81d03af62eec63d0f46165.jpg[/img]
Is the main character who flew to another world a beautiful monster? It is a puzzle RPG where you fight and continue the story. 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2961320/Angry_Boy/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2961320/Angry_Boy/[/url]

[h2][b]4.Secret Psychology[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41454859/e7d09fbba1bc7bf76b29eeb27b39c70de6426da3.jpg[/img]
This is a puzzle/simulation game that heals your mind and body while consulting with these girls. 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2961340/Secret_Psychology/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2961340/Secret_Psychology/[/url]

[h2][b]5.Erocism[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41454859/cd8ef5b61b85f33c0260eb2d152ebda40ffecca3.jpg[/img]
This is an adventure game where you exorcise beautiful ghosts with your cute puppy, ``Taijitsu.''
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2961310/Erocism/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2961310/Erocism/[/url]

We will continue to discover good games and do our best to make them available to everyone. 
We are continuing to update Secret Pie End Roll, so thank you very much for your help. 

thank you. 
All of us at Momentum Games

Best regards,
